subject: Staged adoption gates and monthly token schedule
messages:
From: Emma Porter <emma@fastretail.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: request for MAP + evaluation plan

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the team liked the latency profile and the cost walk-through.

We're trying to lock a short evaluation window (Q1 pilot) and would like a mutual action plan that ties milestones to the commercial terms (so procurement and finance can sign off). High level asks:
- A 90-day evaluation plan with clear acceptance criteria (perf, cost per 1k tokens, tail latency SLOs)
- A proposed staged ramp (month-by-month TPM targets) and corresponding pricing/discount tiers tied to those ramp gates
- Lightweight SOW or commitment sheet we can send to procurement

Can you send a draft MAP + suggested monthly token schedule? Attached is our RFP for context.

Attachments: FastRetail-RFP-v2.pdf (pdf)

—Emma
Emma Porter
Head of Product Integrations, FastRetail
emma@fastretail.com
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Porter <emma@fastretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 10:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: request for MAP + evaluation plan

Hi Emma — great to meet you earlier. Thank you for the RFP; helpful context. Attached is an initial MAP draft and a proposed month-by-month token schedule so your procurement team can see the commercial knobs.

High-level summary (draft):
- 90-day evaluation window (Pilot: Jan 1 — Mar 31) with weekly checkpoints
- Acceptance criteria: 95th pct latency < 300ms (steady-state), generation quality baseline on your test-suite (we'll run a shared eval harness), and error rate < 0.5%
- Staged throughput (tokens/month):
  * Month 1 (pilot start): 2,000,000 tokens
  * Month 2: 6,000,000 tokens
  * Month 3: 15,000,000 tokens
- Pricing/discount triggers: incremental discount tiers at 5M, 12M, 25M cumulative monthly run-rate (draft numbers inside the attached MAP)
- Proposed timeline: sign-off on MAP by Jan 7 to meet production readiness by mid-April

I copied Ben to validate the discount table and Marissa (CS lead) will own the checkpoint cadence in the MAP once Ben and I align on pricing. Please review and flag any immediate redlines.

Attachments: FR-MAP-draft.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 14:21:45 -0800
Subject: RE: Post-demo: request for MAP + evaluation plan

Looping in pricing notes — see inline.

Jasmine — the 3-tier triggers look fine, but recommend we soften the Month 2 jump for FastRetail. Ops has capacity but they are price-sensitive and procurement usually pushes for smaller early commitments. Proposed adjustments:
- Month 1: 2M tokens (pilot) — no discount
- Month 2: 4M tokens — 7% discount on per-token list
- Month 3: 10M tokens — 12% discount on per-token list
- After month 3, ramp to 25M steady state if acceptance criteria met — 18% enterprise rate

If they need a predictable monthly commit (TPM), we can offer a 6-month staged-commit addendum (soft-commit with make-good credits if below threshold). That helps procurement while keeping us covered.

Also suggest including a canary SLO for the first week of production (50k tokens/day) with rollback if 95th pct > 500ms.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Porter <emma@fastretail.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 08:05:30 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan (formal) + SOW (light)

Emma / Paul — attaching a more polished MAP and a lightweight SOW (one page) that procurement can circulate. I captured the adjusted ramp/discounts Ben recommended and added a checkpoint cadence and responsibilities. Important callouts:

MAP highlights (summary):
- Pilot window: 2027-01-03 -> 2027-03-31
- Evaluation acceptance criteria:
  * Quality: pass >= 85% of your labeled test-suite (shared drive)
  * Performance: 95th pct latency <= 300ms for 95% of traffic during pilot
  * Reliability: error rate < 0.5%
- Month-by-month TPM targets (billing tokens):
  * Jan (Pilot month 1): 2,000,000 tokens (no commit)
  * Feb: 4,000,000 tokens (soft commit — 7% discount)
  * Mar: 10,000,000 tokens (hard commit — 12% discount)
  * Post-pilot ramp (Apr+): target 25,000,000 tokens/month (enterprise tier — 18% discount)
- Make-good credit: if month falls short of hard commit, credits applied to next billing cycle (detailed in SOW)
- Canary: first week of production capped at 50k tokens/day; rollback if 95th pct > 500ms

Requested approvals & next steps:
1) FastRetail review & sign MAP + SOW by 2027-01-07 (procurement deadline)
2) DocuSign to be sent by Redwood once redlines are resolved
3) Technical onboarding call scheduled week of 2027-01-03 (Marissa to own)

Attachments: MAP-v1.pdf (pdf), SOW-lite.docx (docx)

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Emma Porter <emma@fastretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 12:13:09 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan (formal) + SOW (light)

Thanks — this is exactly the level of specificity procurement needs. A couple quick asks before we route to legal:
1) Can we shift Feb from 4M -> 5M tokens? That helps internal forecasting and keeps us on track for the Mar ramp.
2) Pricing tweak: can you make the Feb tier a one-time onboarding credit instead of a straight percent discount (we prefer credits applied to first invoice)
3) Region: production must run in us-west (data residency constraint)

If you can update the MAP with those two items I can get procurement to sign by 2027-01-05. Also can you confirm the make-good credit formula (how we calculate credit if we miss a hard commit)?

—Emma
Emma Porter
Head of Product Integrations, FastRetail
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Porter <emma@fastretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan (formal) + SOW (light) — updated items and next steps

Hi Emma — thanks for the quick turnaround and clear asks. Confirming action items we will take today: 
- Update MAP: Feb -> 5,000,000 tokens (soft commit) and switch Feb incentive from percent discount to a $12,500 onboarding credit applied to first invoice
- Add explicit make-good formula to SOW: credit = (committed_tokens - actual_tokens) * agreed_per_token_rate, applied as credit to subsequent invoice (cap: 50% of that invoice)
- Mark production region as us-west in the deployment section
- I will push an updated MAP + SOW to the Drive and trigger DocuSign once procurement confirms no additional legal redlines.

Next milestones:
- Updated MAP & SOW to FastRetail (via Drive + DocuSign link): Tue 2026-12-22 EOD
- Procurement sign-off target: 2027-01-05
- Technical onboarding call: week of 2027-01-03 (Marissa will send invite)

DocuSign link (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/FR-4391-sign
HubSpot deal: https://redwood.hubspot.com/deal/FR-4391

Thanks all — I’ll follow up when DocuSign is live.

—Jasmine
